title: EOS coordinator-assigned claim set
description: org/claims.json, assigned by the integrator and committed to the integration branch before worker dispatch. Versioned state, visible from every worktree via git show. There is no live mutable coordination file, no heartbeat field and no check-then-acquire anywhere: lanes receive claims and never acquire or mutate them. A session not named in the committed unexpired set may not create task records or modify product files.

assigned.description: ISO date the integrator assigned this claim set.

note.description: Integrator note: lane intent, merge order, anything the lanes need to know.

host.description: Liveness identity: the machine the lane runs on. PID checks are only meaningful on the same host.

pid.description: Liveness identity for non-harness local sessions.

harness_task_id.description: Liveness identity for harness-dispatched subagent lanes; the harness task state establishes liveness, so no heartbeat writes exist.

expires.description: Default 24 hours after acquired. An expired claim is recovered only after liveness is checked; a timestamp alone never authorises concurrent ownership.

renewed.description: Set only when a claim came within the renewal window of expiry while the lane was still working.

pathClaim.description: Repository-relative forward-slash NFC path, compared case-folded. An exact path claims one file; a trailing slash claims the directory prefix. Renames and deletes touch both paths; new files must fall under a claimed prefix; derived files belong to the integrator permanently.
